findings.rule_title: Account / Group Identifier Overlap Across Partitions

observed_evidence.note: Zero group overlap confirmed under New-Account protocol.

findings.consequence_explanation: Group partition alignment matches the declared evaluation protocol.

findings.rule_title: Near-Duplicate Records Crossing Partitions (Bounded L2 Check)
findings.consequence_explanation: No unexplained near-duplicate records detected within bounded L2 check.

findings.rule_title: Target or Target-Derived Features Included in Predictors
findings.consequence_explanation: No target or target-derived columns detected in predictors.

findings.rule_title: Feature Availability at Prediction Timestamp (Point-in-Time Audit)
Temporal Ordering and 90-Day Outcome-Window Purge Verification

observed_evidence.note: Protocol A evaluates cross-account generalisation across disjoint account groups; temporal purging is governed under Protocol B.

findings.consequence_explanation: Disjoint account partitioning isolates trajectories across splits.
findings.recommended_correction: Use Protocol B when evaluating forward-in-time production deployment.

findings.consequence_explanation: FitProvenanceRecord confirms 100% of fitted row hashes belong exclusively to the training partition (and training sub-folds during cross-validation).
Resampling boundary is strictly isolated to training data.

findings.rule_title: Identifiers, Timestamps or Lineage Metadata in Predictors
findings.consequence_explanation: All identifiers, timestamps and lineage fields are excluded from predictors.
Zero right-censored outcomes or conflicting (account_id, observation_date) labels in active splits.

findings.rule_title: Covariate and Target Prevalence Shift Across Partitions
findings.consequence_explanation: Covariate distributions and target prevalence remain stable across splits.

audit_report.scope_disclaimer: Audit Scope & Epistemic Limitation: This audit evaluates 11 structural, temporal, duplication and provenance rules against available data and execution metadata. No automated audit can detect every conceivable form of domain-specific or upstream pipeline leakage. A suspicious column name, strong correlation or high model score is never treated as proof of leakage without provenance evidence.

class_prior_baseline.selection_criterion: Max Inner-CV PR-AUC (Average Precision) strictly on Training folds

threshold_selection_summary.hypothetical_cost_assumptions_disclosure: Hypothetical Cost Assumptions: Outreach cost = £55.00 per flagged account; expected retained value per true positive = £420.00. These are illustrative user-configurable assumptions, not verified commercial financial outcomes.

train.pr_auc_convention: PR-AUC is computed via sklearn.metrics.average_precision_score: weighted mean of precisions achieved at each threshold, weighted by the increase in recall from the previous threshold (step-function rectangular integration, avoiding optimistic linear trapezoidal interpolation).

val_development.pr_auc_convention: PR-AUC is computed via sklearn.metrics.average_precision_score: weighted mean of precisions achieved at each threshold, weighted by the increase in recall from the previous threshold (step-function rectangular integration, avoiding optimistic linear trapezoidal interpolation).

test_uncertainty.method: Account-Cluster Bootstrap (250 resamples of 251 unique 'account_id' clusters with replacement)
test_uncertainty.methodological_limitation_disclosure: Dependence & Uncertainty Disclosure: Account-cluster bootstrap accounts for within-account correlation across repeated monthly snapshots. Under Protocol B (Future-Period Prediction), only 2 test monthly waves are observed, so macro-temporal regime variance across multi-year economic cycles cannot be estimated from this finite horizon. Furthermore, confidence intervals on a synthetic benchmark measure finite-sample simulation variance, not real-world generalisation.

latency_benchmark.measurement_procedure: Timed on local CPU via time.perf_counter() across 25 iterations following 3 warm-up passes, including full ColumnTransformer imputation/encoding and probability calibration.

Because the synthetic generator and evaluation pipelines share authorship, reported metrics demonstrate pipeline mechanics, temporal/group boundary enforcement and leakage-audit sensitivity. They do not constitute an independent real-world benchmark or commercial client outcome.

fit_provenance_summary.unknown_category_policy: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'): unseen categories at inference map to an all-zero indicator vector without raising runtime errors; missing categorical values are mapped to explicit '__MISSING__' level.

global_explainability.method: Permutation Importance on Development Partition (Metric: Average Precision / PR-AUC, 8 repeats, seed=20261105)
global_explainability.reference_partition: val_development (Test set untouched for model revision)
global_explainability.non_causal_disclosure: Non-Causal Attribution Notice: Global permutation importances, linear coefficients and instance-level marginal attributions describe associations within the fitted predictive model relative to the training reference distribution. They do not establish causal effects or guarantee that intervening on a feature will alter customer churn.
